programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

programme.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat
programme.sub-title: The Master Pasta Maker of Puglia, Italy
programme.desc: TV and radio host Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera or poor man's cooking.

programme.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat
programme.sub-title: Baking Artisinal Pastries in Mallorca, Spain
programme.desc: Pastry Chef Ravneet Gill takes Fred to Mallorca to experience incredible island cooking, from a buzzing beach bar serving holiday food in the sun, to light and fluffy pastries.

programme.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat
programme.sub-title: Searching for the Best Pizza in Rome, Italy
programme.desc: Chef Giorgio Locatelli takes Fred to Rome in search of the city's most exciting eats. Sublime pasta, fluffy gnocchi and the world's best pizza all delicious but affordable.

programme.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat
programme.sub-title: The Floating Restaurant of Devon, United Kingdom
programme.desc: Fred travels to South Devon with chef and restaurateur Angela Hartnett. From Angela's all-time favourite restaurant in Dartmouth to an incredible floating café on the River Exe.

programme.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat
programme.sub-title: Perfecting Puff Pastry in Burgundy, France
programme.desc: Acclaimed chef Michael Caines takes Fred to Burgundy to amazing places to eat serving the finest French country cooking and exquisite pâtisserie.

programme.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat
programme.sub-title: Exploring Castles and Cozy Inns in South Wales, United Kingdom
programme.desc: Top chefs in England take Fred Sirieix to experience amazing restaurants where they genuinely love to eat.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: In Greece, the Intercity Express travels from Thessaloniki to Athens, passing sites like the Meteora peaks, Delphi ruins and the Acropolis; the journey continues to the Peloponnese on Greece's last cogwheel train.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: The Cinque Terre Express runs along Italy's northern coast east of Genoa; passing through five UNESCO-listed villages, it offers coastal views and access to cobbled streets, harbors, terraced vineyards and pastel-colored houses.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: In Portugal, in the Douro River Valley, a steam locomotive and a small historic train will take you in turn to the water's edge, on the only railroad line in the world that crosses three World Heritage Sites classified by UNESCO.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: The Little Yellow Train winds through the Eastern Pyrenees, crossing the Cerdan plateau, the historic Gisclard railway suspension bridge and the Grandes Canalettes caves, known as the underground Versailles of the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: Corsica, the Island of Beauty, is best explored by railway; from Mediterranean waters to towering peaks, stops include Algajola for a seaside dive, Vizzavona on the GR20 trail and historic cities like Corte with its citadel.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: Andalusia, now crossed by high-speed and modernized rail lines, unveils its rich culture and landscapes; along the journey, we visit cities like Seville, Granada with its famed Alhambra and Guadix near the Tabernas Desert.

programme.title: The Pizza City You've Never Heard Of
programme.desc: Disturbed by the fact that his hometown of Windsor, Ontario is typically overlooked on lists of the top pizza cities in the world, George Kalivas goes on a mission to set the record straight about where to find the best pies on the planet.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.sub-title: Best of Salina's Land and Sea
programme.desc: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

programme.title: Nadie te querrá como yo

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Garry Shandling (3/18/81)
programme.desc: The genius behind the Larry Sanders Show and his namesake program, The Garry Shandling Show, Gary delivers huge laughs over laundromats, dinner with his dad and visiting friends with who have babies.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Richard Lewis (3/27/81)
programme.desc: Years before his buddy Larry David cast him in Curb Your Enthusiasm, comic Richard Lewis did breakthrough stand up with stories about trying to cure his herpes and loading up on vitamins.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Betty White (8/14/81)
programme.desc: Eight-time Emmy winner, Betty White wanted to be a forest ranger, but that gig was off limits to women in the early 1940s. She turned to writing and was the first woman to produce a sitcom.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Eddie Murphy (1/1/82)
programme.desc: Actor/Comedian Eddie Murphy shows an SNL clip in which he impersonates Bill Cosby. Shares his observation that there are no black people in Beverly Hills.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Richard Pryor (2/9/83)
programme.desc: The king of stand up, Richard Pryor discusses his recent trip to Zimbabwe, and daily life since quitting drugs and alcohol.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Eddie Murphy (6/24/83)
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy discusses his hero Richard Pryor, and talks about his film Trading Places.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Chevy Chase (7/22/83)
programme.desc: Chevy Chase not only promotes his movie, National Lampoon's Vacation, but brings a tennis racquet on stage and demonstrates his serve.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Chevy Chase (7/22/83)
programme.desc: Chevy Chase not only promotes his movie, National Lampoon's Vacation, but brings a tennis racquet on stage and demonstrates his serve.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Charles Grodin (12/9/83)
programme.desc: Frequent guest Charles Grodin discusses his movie The Lonely Guy, which also stars Steve Martin. Also featured are radio legends Bob & Ray.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Charles Grodin (6/8/84)
programme.desc: Charles Grodin talks about working with 'tough guy' Charles Bronson. Stand-up comedian Brad talks about the challenges of dating when you're 6"9'.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - David Letterman (7/13/84)
programme.desc: Fellow late night host David Letterman stops by to talk about muggings in New York and earthquakes in Los Angeles. Scot Morris also stops by.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Louie Anderson (11/20/84)
programme.desc: For his first appearance on 'The Tonight Show' Louie Anderson pays tribute to his parents and his home state, Minnesota. Also appearing is Robert Blake.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Steven Wright (12/12/84)
programme.desc: The king of dry humor, Steven Wright talks about everything from his girlfriend to filming a small part in his first movie.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Chevy Chase (5/30/85)
programme.desc: To celebrate turning 40 Chevy Chase joins Johnny to talk about his new movie, Fletch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dan Aykroyd (11/29/85)
programme.desc: This turbo-charged episode featured the comedy triumvirate of David Letterman, Chevy Chase and Dan Aykroyd. So many jokes, so little time.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dan Aykroyd (11/29/85)
programme.desc: This turbo-charged episode featured the comedy triumvirate of David Letterman, Chevy Chase and Dan Aykroyd. So many jokes, so little time.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Father Guido Sarducci (2/28/86)
programme.desc: Father Guido Sarducci stops by the set to talk about his pet dog and starting his own church. Plus, Rube Goldberg contest winner Robin Barnett and legendary film critics Gene Siskel & Roger Ebert make appearances.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Steven Wright (5/28/86)
programme.desc: Steven Wright brings his signature monotone to the show and Rose Gries discusses being the oldest Avon Lady. Plus Johnny jokes about air quality and notes the human brain has gotten smaller.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Billy Crystal (6/11/86)
programme.desc: Billy Crystal does impressions and sounds off on cable TV vs. satellite dishes, Arnold Schwarzenegger works out for an hour a day and Michael Ammar does card tricks with all of them.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Charles Grodin (8/1/86)
programme.desc: Charles Grodin clears the air, Dom Irrera does stand-up about parking lot attendants and Tommy Walton is a world-famous hot dog vendor. Plus, Johnny jokes about Meryl Streep, Pat Sajak and Dustin Hoffman in the monologue.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Chevy Chase (12/12/86)
programme.desc: Comedy superstar Chevy Chase stops by to talk about having perfect pitch and guest hosting the show. Siskel & Ebert reveal their favorite Chevy Chase movie.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dana Carvey (3/11/87)
programme.desc: The Church Lady makes an appearance on the show when Dana Carvey stops by and does impressions. Plus, Christopher Reeve talks Superman and Frank Olivier does a juggling/comedy act.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Ellen DeGeneres (5/21/87)
programme.desc: Ellen DeGeneres does stand-up and Eddie Murphy talks Beverly Hills Cop II. Jane Leeves also stops by.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dan Aykroyd (6/25/87)
programme.desc: Dan Aykroyd talks Dragnet and Bobby Kelton performs stand-up. Helen Shaver also appears and Johnny takes on last night's stupid audience in the monologue.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dan Aykroyd (6/25/87)
programme.desc: Dan Aykroyd talks Dragnet and Bobby Kelton performs stand-up. Helen Shaver also appears and Johnny takes on last night's stupid audience in the monologue.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Jon Lovitz (9/1/87)
programme.desc: Saturday Night Live's Jon Lovitz talks growing up in The Valley and living in New York. Plus, Paul Sorvino stops by and Abbe Jaye shows off her talents as a nose flutist.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dana Carvey (5/12/88)
programme.desc: Dana Carvey discusses his Saturday Night Live characters and being vaguely famous. Also appearing are author Joe Garagiola and pranksters David Teitelbaum and Jack Saltzberg.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Chevy Chase (5/26/88)
programme.desc: Chevy Chase is afraid of snakes and spiders! Plus, John Sutter and Thalassa Cruso stop by and Johnny jokes about a supermarket sushi shoplifter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Martin Short (1/31/90)
programme.desc: Comic icon Martin Short discusses Canadian Football and does a few impressions, while Cathy Ladman and Bonnie Hunt also stop by.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Dave Thomas (6/1/90)
programme.desc: Witness Dave Thomas' Bob Hope and Andrew Dice Clay impressions. Plus: Buddy Hackett tells jokes and Teresa Ganzel also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Charles Grodin (9/5/90)
programme.desc: Johnny isn't interested in what Charles Grodin has to say, but you might be. B.B. King and Amy Yasbeck also grace the couch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - John Candy (5/17/91)
